prompt:
Style: a sky plate for an offline-rendered 3D computer graphics background of the late 1990s, the kind of matte sky that was composited behind ray-traced scenes for pre-rendered game backgrounds. Only sky: no land, no sea, no islands, no hills, no buildings, no lighthouse, no birds, no sun disc, no lens flare. Photographic and smooth: soft gradients, soft-edged volumetric clouds, fine film grain, slightly desaturated cinematic colour grading. Not a cartoon, not a brush painting, not an illustration.
Composition: the bottom edge of the image is the horizon line. Along the bottom fifth runs a band of warm orange and peach afterglow (the sun has just set slightly left of centre); above it the sky turns dusty rose and muted violet, deepening to dark navy blue at the top edge. A few long, flat, low stratus clouds across the lower half, their undersides lit orange and pink, their tops blue-grey. Small faint stars in the upper third only. The colours at the left and right edges match, so the plate can wrap around horizontally.
The sky belongs to this scene (context only, paint nothing but its sky): Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.

Style: a sheet of photographic surface textures for offline-rendered 3D computer graphics of the late 1990s, as used on the models of pre-rendered game backgrounds. Sixteen square textures arranged in an exact 4 by 4 grid of equal squares, separated by straight, even gutters of pure black (#000000), with a pure black border around the whole sheet. Every square is filled edge to edge with one flat surface material, photographed straight on (orthographic, no perspective, no objects, no frame, no vignette). Realistic photographic detail with natural wear, dirt and colour variation, crisp at about 256 pixels per square. Flat, even, neutral overcast lighting: no baked-in shadows, no highlights, no light direction, no darkening towards the edges (the renderer lights them). Each texture must tile seamlessly: the pattern continues across the left/right and top/bottom edges without seams, and the brightness is even across the square.
Row 1, left to right: (1) grey granite paving slab surface with fine speckles and a few small yellow-grey lichen spots, no joints; (2) rough fieldstone house wall, irregular grey and brown stones set in pale lime mortar; (3) dark weathered granite blocks of a harbour wall in horizontal courses with dark joints; (4) weathered grey-brown wooden planks running horizontally, visible grain, a few rusty nail heads.
Row 2: (5) dark tarred wooden planks running horizontally, almost black-brown, slightly glossy grain; (6) weathered whitewashed lime plaster, off-white with faint grey streaks; (7) weathered red paint on plaster, deep brick red with small chips showing grey under it; (8) dark blue-grey slate roof tiles in overlapping horizontal rows.
Row 3: (9) coarse twisted hemp rope fibres running diagonally, beige-brown; (10) rusty dark cast iron, dark grey with brown and orange rust patches; (11) rugged coastal rock, grey-brown with cracks and pale lichen; (12) damp pale beach sand with small pebbles and shell fragments.
Row 4: (13) coarse short coastal grass and moss, muted olive green with a few brown patches; (14) weathered white-painted wooden boat planks running horizontally with thin dark seams; (15) weathered red-painted wooden boat planks running horizontally with thin dark seams; (16) wet dark green-grey stone covered with algae and barnacles, as at the waterline of a harbour wall.
The materials are for a small stone fishing harbour on a fictional island in a northern sea (only the materials, not the scene).
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: square 1:1.
